validation.regression: Returning proposal reuses current geometry; changed geometry triggers cold retry; history expires. Compiled against old matching headers/core, the added return-to-ranking assertions fail.

serial_basins_v1.reason: Tiny CPU saving on 08/14 and negative; negative wall increases 5.6%, with slightly worse 08/14 first-lock wall. Reject instead of trading latency for this CPU saving.

leaf_batch_v2.reason: All three focused prefixes increase CPU about 3%; full 60-frame negative CPU also increases from 102.054 to 106.083 s. Exactness/E2E passed but end-to-end cost did not improve.

separation_v3.reason: Unique-nearest proof and focused E2E pass. Prefix CPU drops 2-6% and negative CPU drops 4.6%, but preparation adds load cost/derived storage and first-lock wall does not consistently improve. Defer rather than retain this added state for a small measured benefit.
separation_v3.scope: Certificate computed once only for immutable loaded Atlas levels; no map bytes or matching gates changed.

final.reason: Full14 CPU essentially unchanged; negative full CPU increased 1.115%, despite passing correctness.

continuation_v6.reason: No reduced work in 60-frame negative: both 242 registrations, 128 cold starts, 10 resumptions, 1 retry; CPU 101.951->102.227 s. Full baseline has only8 retries versus1015 cold starts, so this is not the main bottleneck.
continuation_v6.scope: focused tests and three positive prefixes passed; full negative not run for this rejected variant

leaf_history_v9.reason: Inconsistent prefix results (03 CPU +6.02%,08 -0.83%,14 -1.40%); negative60 only -1.56%, insufficient to justify derived boxes/preparation/API surface. Retain bounded history alone.
leaf_history_v9.scope: focused matcher/default E2E plus 3 paired prefixes and negative60, not full14 qualification; local double-box NN micro is not pipeline evidence

limitations: Difficult-search half-core has not been met. Four physical cores limit execution; CPU/input measures demand at original 10 Hz, not actual simultaneously occupied cores.
10 cm absolute accuracy remains unaccepted; prior map bias diagnosis is not runtime correction.
Synthetic out/reentry E2E and safe refusal on this moving negative do not establish full moving out/reentry acquisition or RK3588 deployment.
One complete paired timing experiment; per-case small timing differences may be noise.

test_reorganization.noetic: Same source list wired; no new Noetic native build qualification claimed.

decision: Retain only bounded 32-plan pose-proposal history. Full moving-negative CPU -13.245%, registrations1678->1402 and cold starts1015->720, zero false locks. Full14 poses/decisions unchanged; total startup CPU effectively unchanged and startup wall does not consistently improve. Half-core/10cm and broader motion coverage remain open.

focused_repeats.scope: Two counterbalanced prefix pairs per03/14, after full14; screening startup timing, not whole-episode half-core evidence

findings: Partial map incorrectly locks at 92.599995 s with 96.669446 m / 179.999440 deg error, despite fresh geometry, directional support 0.577255 and full temporal confirmation. Recovers at 168.999990 s; safety fails.

Full map stays locked but develops a 4.399767 m / up-to-9.005996 deg tracking excursion. Normal localization bypasses visibility and correction-size checks used by map-extension tracking; causal A/B remains to do.

Four-core CPU demand is 10.414539 CPU s/input s for partial map and 0.625267 for full map; neither is a half-core pass. Partial replay backlog makes its early timestamped locks unsuitable for real-time latency claims.

True outside-map aliasing cannot be dismissed as a descriptor-dimension or stale-cache issue; investigate continuity from prior trusted map/odometry without suppressing independent initial candidates or legitimate recovery.

exact_grid_rejected.scope: One serial main-thread ABBA kernel test per realcloud/targetlevel/hintmode; gate_squared=1.0 as an isolated search probe, not product optimizer gate validation. No end-to-end benefit claimed.
exact_grid_rejected.decision: Reject grid indexing before production integration
exact_grid_rejected.reason: All fine/refine cases slower; coarse case gain inconsistent; high metadata memory. No production change.
